title: IEEG004: A library of human electrocorticographic data and analyses (Kai J. Miller) - calibrated task subset
description: A calibrated task subset of Kai J. Miller's library of human electrocorticographic (ECoG) data, comprising 111 recordings from 24 epilepsy patients with subdural electrode grids. Tasks include finger flexion, hand gestures, motor movement and imagery, verb generation, and noun reading. Data were recorded at 1 kHz on Synamps2 amplifiers and converted to BIDS (BrainVision format) with events and electrode positions.
methods_description: Subdural ECoG was recorded at Harborview Hospital in Seattle with Synamps2 amplifiers at 1000 Hz, using a hardware band pass of 0.15-200 Hz and BCI2000 acquisition software. Source MATLAB task files were converted to BrainVision with MNE-BIDS and scaled to volts with the documented factor of 0.0298 µV per amplifier unit. No filtering, resampling, or re-referencing was applied. Stimulus codes were exported as events and as a STIMCODE channel.
